name: Lenka Horáková
bio:
Lenka Horáková's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not with a burning passion for racing itself, but with an insatiable curiosity for how things work. Her early career involved repairing agricultural machinery, a grounding that instilled in her a deep understanding of mechanical principles. This eventually led her to a local karting club, where she volunteered her skills, quickly becoming indispensable. 

Lenka's approach to machining is meticulous and pragmatic. She values precision above all else, often spending hours refining a single component until it meets her exacting standards. While she appreciates innovative designs, she also emphasizes reliability and durability, believing that even the most ingenious idea is useless if it can't withstand the rigors of the track. Her demanding nature pushes those around her to perform at their best, sometimes resulting in friction, but always with the goal of achieving perfection. She recently joined the Junior Kart Team, seeking to apply her experience to nurturing young talent.

Lenka sets herself apart with her pragmatic approach and high standards. She doesn't just fix problems; she anticipates them, ensuring that the karts are always in peak condition. Her dedication and no-nonsense attitude make her a valuable, if sometimes challenging, asset to any team.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, pulled back in a practical ponytail with a few strands escaping around her face.
physical.description: Lenka is a woman of medium build, with calloused hands that speak to years of working with metal.

quirks: Always sharpens her pencils to an impossibly fine point.
Insists on using only metric measurements, even when others use imperial.
Has a habit of humming quietly while she works, often Czech folk songs.
